employment.censoNote: Activity = active / pop. 14+. Employment = employed / pop. 14+. Unemployment = unemployed / active pop.
employment.ofWhichRegistered: Of salaried workers, how many are registered?
employment.compositionNote: Private and public: SIPA-registered salaried 2023. Gap: informal + not covered (includes 13 provinces with their own pension funds, whose provincial employees don't appear in SIPA).
employment.splitDnapNote: Census 2022 counts persons whose main occupation is public administration, education or health (any level of government). DNAP 2024 counts provincial positions (Central Admin + decentralized + special accounts). Scopes don't align: one person can hold several positions, and DNAP excludes national and municipal jobs.
employment.evolutionNote: Dashed line = 2024 national average ({{avg}} / 1,000). Source: DNAP annual series 1987–2024.
employment.footer: Labor-market rates come from the INDEC 2022 Census (population 14+ in private dwellings) — a full count, not a sample. Private figures (SIPA) exclude informal work and self-employed not registered. Public figures (DNAP) count filled posts (not people — a teacher with two tenures counts twice) in the provincial Central Administration + Decentralised Agencies + Special Accounts, December of each year, and exclude: municipal and national employment, state-owned enterprises, provincial pension funds, trust funds, and contract/grant/internship posts charged to other budget lines.

exportsSec.desc: Provincial exports in USD millions. PP: primary products, MOA: agricultural manufactures, MOI: industrial manufactures, F&E: fuels & energy. Source: INDEC.

fiscal.fiscalSourceLong: Source: Mecon DNAP (APNF 2005–{{year}}). Each year normalized to 100% — invariant to inflation. Non-automatic = transfers outside the coparticipación law (ATN, convenios, fondos compensadores, obra pública nacional). Historical automatic/non-automatic split estimated using the latest year's ratio.
fiscal.depTooltip: Share of provincial revenues coming from national transfers, under the classic APNF formula: % = National Transfers ÷ (Own Revenue + Royalties + Other Non-Tax + National Transfers). Social-security contributions (CSS) are excluded from the denominator; that's why the % can differ from the official DNAP dashboard, whose "Ingresos de gestión provincial" metric does include CSS (and therefore shows a lower number). Non-automatic share = nationalTransfers − coparticipation. Sparkline shows the 2005→latest series (Mecon DNAP).

debt.title: Provincial public debt ({{asOf}})
debt.sourceLong: Source: Mecon DNAP — Provincial Debt Stock Q3 2025 (as of Sep-30-25). Bonds at residual value, in pesos at official closing FX rate. Excludes floating and contingent debt.
